content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The append is where the write meets the read it consumes and the interface that owns it; the gate forces the append form to contradict neither — the entry lands as a line at the end of the contents the read returned, and the interface that owns the file stays the writer — without re-deciding either.
